info.description: Self-hosted media server for movies, TV shows, and music
info.title: ViewRA Media Server API

get.description: Browse directories for library path selection

post.description: Returns images for multiple media items in a single request to reduce N+1 queries
post.summary: Get images for multiple media items

get.description: Returns metadata for a specific image

Serves pre-generated image presets. All images are in WebP format with multiple sizes available.
Available presets: thumb, medium, large, xlarge (depending on image type).
If no preset is specified, serves the medium size by default.
Returns a list of all libraries
Returns details of a specific library

delete.description: Deletes a library and all its media entries (does not delete files)

post.description: Scans a library for media files

get.description: Returns the last N scan jobs for a library, ordered by creation date (newest first)

parameters.description: Number of scan jobs to return (default 10, max 100)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns the current status of the most recent scan job for a library

404.description: No scan jobs found for this library

get.description: Streams real-time progress updates for an active scan job using Server-Sent Events
Returns a list of media items with optional filtering

parameters.description: Filter by library ID (omit to list all media)
parameters.name: library_id

parameters.description: Filter by media type (movie, episode, track)
parameters.name: type

get.description: Returns details of a specific media item
get.summary: Get a media item by ID

get.description: Returns all images associated with a specific media item
get.summary: Get all images for a media item

get.description:
Serves the HLS playlist (.m3u8) file for adaptive streaming. If playlist doesn't exist, analyzes video
and either redirects to direct stream or creates a transcode job.

302.description: Redirect to direct stream (for compatible files)

get.description: Serves HLS segment files (.ts) for adaptive streaming

post.description: Creates a new transcode job for the specified media and quality level

get.description: Gets the status of a transcode job for specific media and quality

post.description: Cancels an actively transcoding job (called when user pauses/stops video)

get.description: Returns a list of all movies in a specific library with optional pagination

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 50, max: 200)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Searches for movies by title in a specific library with optional pagination

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 50, max: 200)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns details of a specific movie including all metadata
Returns all images (poster, fanart, clearlogo, etc.) for a specific movie
get.summary: Get all images for a movie

get.description: Returns all images (cover, discart, etc.) for a specific music album
get.summary: Get all images for a music album

get.description: Returns all tracks for an album identified by a representative track ID
get.summary: List tracks for an album by ID

get.description: Returns a list of all artists in a library with album and track counts and optional pagination

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 50, max: 200)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns all albums for an artist identified by a representative track ID
get.summary: List albums for an artist by ID

get.description: Returns all images (folder, fanart, banner, logo) for a specific music artist
get.summary: Get all images for a music artist

get.description: Searches for music tracks by title, artist, or album in a specific library
Returns details of a specific music track including all metadata
get.summary: Get a music track by ID

get.description: Gets all watch progress records for the current user

put.description: Updates or creates watch progress for a media item. Automatically marks as watched if progress exceeds 90%.

get.description: Gets all in-progress (partially watched) media items for the current user

post.description: Resets the watched status and progress for a media item
Explicitly marks a media item as fully watched

get.description: Gets all watched media items for the current user
Gets watch progress for a specific media item

delete.description: Deletes watch progress for a specific media item

get.description: Streams a media file with HTTP range request support for seeking

post.description: Cleans up transcode files based on specified criteria

get.description: Returns current disk usage statistics for transcode files
Gets current statistics about the transcode job queue
Returns details of a specific TV episode including all metadata
get.summary: Get a TV episode by ID

get.description: Returns all images (primarily thumbnails) for a specific episode
get.summary: Get all images for a TV episode

get.description: Searches for TV shows and episodes by title in a specific library

parameters.description: Search query (show title or episode title)
parameters.name: q

get.description: Returns all images (primarily season posters) for a specific TV season
get.summary: Get all images for a TV season

get.description: Returns a list of all TV shows in a library with episode and season counts and optional pagination

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 50, max: 200)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns details of a specific TV show including season and episode counts
get.summary: Get a TV show by ID

get.description: Returns all episodes for a specific TV show using its ID
get.summary: List episodes for a TV show by ID

get.description: Returns all images (poster, fanart, clearlogo, banner, etc.) for a specific TV show
get.summary: Get all images for a TV show

get.description: Returns all episodes for a specific TV show
get.summary: List episodes for a TV show

get.description: Returns comprehensive health status of the application and its dependencies

is_extra.description: True for trailers, deleted scenes, etc.

hasMore.description: Whether there are more items available

total.description: Total number of items across all pages

type.description: Job type: remux, remux_audio, or transcode
